title: First Apprentice Paycheck: Spend, Save or Invest? 💶 #shorts
description:
Spend, save or invest? Comment 1, 2 or 3.

Germany's minimum apprentice pay 2026 (1st year): 724 € gross → about 571 € net (no income tax, about 153 € social insurance; under 23, no kids, avg. health add-on 2.9 %). Invest 57 € a month for 3 years from age 16, then stop: 2,052 € paid in could be about 39,900 € at 67 at an assumed ~6 % a year (before tax and inflation; about 14,500 € in today's money at 2 % inflation). Returns are not guaranteed; values go up and down.

Sources: BIBB (Mindestausbildungsvergütung 2026), TK & Haufe (contribution rates 2026), Lexware (Grundfreibetrag 2026), Finanztip (6 % planning return)

Not financial advice.
